# Agent Tools

> A curated directory of open-source AI agent tools for marketing and growth teams, in English and Spanish, maintained by fluyeporlaweb (Fluye Labs).

Maintainer: fluyeporlaweb (https://x.com/fluyeporlaweb).
License: MIT (https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/ai-agent-tools/blob/main/LICENSE).
Repository: https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/ai-agent-tools
Sponsor: https://fluyeporlaweb.com/patrocina
Email: colab@fluyeporlaweb.com

## What this is

An awesome list, not a monorepo of every tool we build. Entries are curated (one line, one working link): agent frameworks, coding agents, MCP servers and clients, browser automation and sandboxes, memory and RAG, observability, and prospecting / SEO tools. Some links are affiliates (marked in the README); see https://fluyeporlaweb.com/legal/afiliacion/. Links are re-checked weekly.

## Built by fluyeporlaweb

- prospectforge: open-source B2B lead pipeline (discover, qualify, draft). Dry-run by default. Never sends email. https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/prospectforge
- Apify actors: scrapers and automations published at https://apify.com/fluyeporlaweb
